title: upstream: OpenMLS PublicGroup lacks lifetime opt-out
description: OpenMLS PublicGroup hard-codes leaf lifetime verification (from_external and commit validation); the skip path exists only under test cfg. RFC 9420 §7.3 makes the check RECOMMENDED for received leaves, and the mlswg passive-client vectors have expired leaves. Patched on our fork per mimid-1wgh.4.38 / .4.39. Related upstream issue #1810. Report/PR only with Mark's explicit per-action OK.
notes: Upstream check 2026-10-17: REPORTED, OPEN. openmls/openmls issue #2232 'Caller-supplied time (or lifetime policy) for leaf lifetime validation on Add and PublicGroup::from_external' (opened 2026-09-23, open; maintainer kkohbrok offered to review a PR), https://github.com/openmls/openmls/issues/2232 — exactly our case. Draft PR #2257 'feat: pass the leaf node lifetime policy per call' (opened 2026-10-05, open) adds PublicGroup::from_external_with_lifetime_policy, process_message_with_lifetime_policy and LeafNodeLifetimePolicy::VerifyAt — close to our fork patch d052e72. #1810 (closed) covered only the Welcome tree, fixed by #1814 skip_lifetime_validation; #1856 (open) 'skip lifetime validation not being respected' is loosely related. Action: track #2257; when it lands/releases, move our fork to its API. Any comment on #2232/#2257 needs Mark's OK.
